entities.summary:
Marpaung is one of Toba Batak clans originating in North Sumatra, Indonesia. People of this clan bear the clan's name as their surname. Notable people of this clan include:Novita Dewi Marpaung, Indonesian singer
Nurhajizah Marpaung, Indonesian military officer and politician
